fetch.digest: sha256 of the decoded text, CRLF folded to LF

supersedes.why_it_was_wrong: its fetch did not fail on an HTTP error, retried nothing, and counted every request that did not return the recorded digest as a file that no longer exists; re-fetched with retries, every one of the 18 verified against its recorded digest

what_this_is: every file of the third-party manifest re-fetched at its recorded commit, checked against its recorded digest, and judged again by the current adapter
